instruction: I received a document listing essential Chrome extensions for developers. Please visit the Chrome Web Store and install the first three extensions mentioned in the document.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the first 3 Chrome extensions from the document (Zoom Chrome Extension, Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader, React Developer Tools). The evaluator uses custom getter to retrieve installed extension names from Chrome Preferences file and custom metric to verify all 3 expected extensions are installed. Verified against the actual document content which lists these 3 extensions at positions 2-4 (after the header).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: Properly reads Chrome Preferences file across different OS platforms and extracts installed extension names from the manifest
Metric logic is correct: Uses appropriate subset check to verify all expected extensions are installed, with binary scoring (1.0 if all found, 0.0 otherwise)
Parameter handling is correct: Metric properly accesses expected.get('expected') to retrieve the list of extension names from the rules dictionary
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all 3 required extensions as specified in the instruction
Data compatibility: Getter returns List[str], metric expects List[str], expected value is List[str] - perfect semantic alignment
State accessibility: Installed Chrome extensions persist in Preferences file, no postconfig needed
Expected values verified: The 3 extension names match the actual document content and instruction requirements
Edge cases handled: Both getter and metric have proper error handling for empty results and missing data
